question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a white ball, and Claire has a red ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Bob and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) white ball
(C) red ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (yellow, white, red)
1. Claire and Bob swap: (yellow, red, white)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (yellow, white, red)
3. Bob and Alice swap: (white, yellow, red)
Claire has the red ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
